subject.character: ONE garden snail, big in frame, grey-olive body, clear face, eyes on long stalks, small mouth; brown shell with a brass padlock and iron chain; same face throughout
subject.physicality: stalks snap in and out; skates on wet stone, slime glinting; skids sideways; hauls in jerks

second_characters: ONE fat banker, greasy suit, sleeve protectors, silent, rides on the desk behind the register
props: old cash register, blank keys, no digits; wooden work desk; coin: smooth gold, no engraving; padlock: smooth brass
environment: wet stone garden step; dense background: wet leaves, moss, drops, clay pots
lighting: warm sun edge behind-left, cool cyan sky edge behind-right on both figures, glints on brass and gold, bright
motion_rule: The snail big. Camera orbits every beat and changes shot size, medium to close; background slides behind. He skates, skids or hauls every beat. The banker works big in the foreground.

audio.delivery: flat low brisk male voice, native, no accent; first word on frame one; stress VYgodny
audio.pacing: brisk, each line once inside its beat, nothing said after 6.3

timeline.a: mouth opens on every syllable; he skates across wet stone left to right as a fat hand in a sleeve protector slaps a gold coin onto the stone near frame edge; camera arcs left to right
mouth opens on every syllable; he skates toward the coin, stalks snapping out, as the banker's finger flicks it rolling to him; camera arcs right to left
mouth opens on every syllable; he rolls onto the coin and skids sideways, it sticks to his sole, as the banker yanks the chain; camera orbits with the skid
he skates off and is jerked round in an arc, shell bouncing, as the banker hauls the chain hand over hand; orbit against the jerk
mouth opens on every syllable; he slides backward on the taut chain, stalks swinging to the desk, as the banker, on the desk, reels him in, belly wobbling; camera arcs
mouth opens on every syllable; he skids round on the chain, jabbing a stalk at the banker, who cranks the register handle, the drawer shooting open; low arc
mouth opens on every syllable; he swings in a wide arc round the desk, both stalks pointing at his own chest, as the banker spins the register after him, drawer open; camera orbits with the swing
he skids into a desk leg, the coin flies off his sole into the drawer, as the banker slams it shut with his belly; arc against the skid
he hauls in a jerk, the desk lurching after him, as the banker licks his fingers big in the foreground; camera orbits both
he drags the desk round a clay pot, desk legs scraping, as the banker cranks the handle; orbit against the drag
he hauls over wet moss, slime spraying, as the banker sways hugging the register; low arc, moss sliding
he skids the other way, the desk swinging behind, as the banker bounces slapping the register; orbit the other way
he drags the desk on, shell bouncing, as the banker licks a finger and cranks; arc

must_appear: 0.00 padlock and chain on shell; 1.90 coin sticks to his sole; 4.25-6.30 drawer open; 6.30 coin into the drawer; final: snail drags the desk, banker licks a finger
negative_prompt: small hero, wide shot, static camera, a parked hero, a hero standing still, a focus pull, a cart, a rail, wheels, a repeated word, a second animal, text, letters, digits, subtitles, watermark, engraving, duplicate props, darkness, spotlights, floating objects, slow speech, speech after 6.4, foreign accent
